description: Documented Adfox getCode and goLink simple links. Checks the published numeric randomization value from 1 through 4294967295. Runtime event URLs, including pr=a, remain outside this simple-link contract.

params.name: pr
params.description: Adfox requires its simple links to be randomized with an integer from 1 through 4294967295. This does not test randomness or per-request uniqueness.
